SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=0)

mapper.update: UPDATE exception_case SET status=#{toStatus},responsible_party=COALESCE(#{responsibleParty},responsible_party),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{exceptionId} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE exception_case SET version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{exceptionId} AND status <> 'CLOSED' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS exception_id,e.status AS exception_status,o.current_status AS order_status,o.currency AS order_currency FROM exception_case e JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=e.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.id=#{exceptionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM claim_record c LEFT JOIN sys_user finance ON finance.id=c.finance_confirmed_by_user_id AND finance.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.exception_case_id=#{exceptionId}
SELECT FROM claim_record c LEFT JOIN sys_user finance ON finance.id=c.finance_confirmed_by_user_id AND finance.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.claim_no=#{claimNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE claim_record SET status=#{toStatus},submitted_at=COALESCE(#{submittedAt},submitted_at),resolved_at=COALESCE(#{resolvedAt},resolved_at),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{claimId} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE claim_record SET status=#{toStatus},resolved_amount=#{resolvedAmount},result_reason=#{resultReason},resolved_at=#{resolvedAt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{claimId} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE claim_record SET finance_confirmed_by_user_id=#{operatorUserId},finance_confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{claimId} AND status IN ('APPROVED','PARTIALLY_APPROVED','REJECTED') AND finance_confirmed_at IS NULL AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exception_evidence_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND exception_case_id=#{exceptionId} AND id=#{attachmentId})
SELECT evidence_attachment_id FROM claim_evidence_reference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND claim_record_id=#{claimId} ORDER BY id

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exception_case e JOIN claim_record c ON c.exception_case_id=e.id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.id=#{exceptionId} AND e.status='PENDING_FINANCE_CONFIRMATION' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED','PARTIALLY_APPROVED','REJECTED','CLOSED') AND c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND c.finance_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exception_handling_record h WHERE h.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND h.exception_case_id=e.id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exception_evidence_attachment a WHERE a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.exception_case_id=e.id))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exception_case e LEFT JOIN claim_record c ON c.exception_case_id=e.id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.id=#{exceptionId} AND e.status='RESOLVED' AND (c.id IS NULL OR (c.finance_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.status='CLOSED')))

SELECT h.id,h.tenant_id,h.exception_case_id,h.record_no,h.handled_by_user_id,h.record_type,h.content,h.created_at FROM exception_handling_record h JOIN exception_case e ON e.id=h.exception_case_id AND e.tenant_id=h.tenant_id JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=e.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND h.exception_case_id=#{exceptionId} AND ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.id DESC

SELECT id,tenant_id,exception_case_id,record_no,handled_by_user_id,record_type,content,created_at FROM exception_handling_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND exception_case_id=#{exceptionId} AND record_no=#{recordNo}
SELECT id,tenant_id,exception_case_id,record_no,handled_by_user_id,record_type,content,created_at FROM exception_handling_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{recordId}

SELECT a.id,a.tenant_id,a.exception_case_id,a.uploaded_by_user_id,a.original_file_name,a.content_type,a.file_size,a.content_sha256,NULL AS content,a.description,a.created_at FROM exception_evidence_attachment a JOIN exception_case e ON e.id=a.exception_case_id AND e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=e.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.exception_case_id=#{exceptionId} AND ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC

SELECT a.id,a.tenant_id,a.exception_case_id,a.uploaded_by_user_id,a.original_file_name,a.content_type,a.file_size,a.content_sha256,a.content_blob AS content,a.description,a.created_at FROM exception_evidence_attachment a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{attachmentId}

SELECT a.id,a.tenant_id,a.exception_case_id,a.uploaded_by_user_id,a.original_file_name,a.content_type,a.file_size,a.content_sha256,a.content_blob AS content,a.description,a.created_at FROM exception_evidence_attachment a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.exception_case_id=#{exceptionId} AND a.content_sha256=#{contentSha256}
SELECT request_hash,resource_id FROM api_idempotency_record WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE api_idempotency_record SET resource_type=#{resourceType},resource_id=#{resourceId},processing_status='SUCCEEDED',response_status=201 WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id,operator_user_id,action_type,resource_type,resource_id,request_id,result_status,reason,detail,occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{operatorUserId},#{actionType},#{resourceType},#{resourceId},#{requestId},'SUCCESS',#{reason},CAST(#{detail} AS JSON),#{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.action_type AS event_type,REPLACE(a.action_type,'_',' ') AS title,a.reason AS description,a.operator_user_id,u.display_name AS operator_name,a.resource_type AS source,a.occurred_at,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.detail,'$.fromStatus')) AS status_before,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.detail,'$.toStatus')) AS status_after,a.resource_id AS related_id,a.request_id FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.operator_user_id AND u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ((a.resource_type='EXCEPTION_CASE' AND a.resource_id=#{exceptionId}) OR (a.resource_type='CLAIM_RECORD' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM claim_record c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.exception_case_id=#{exceptionId} AND c.id=a.resource_id)) OR (a.resource_type='EXCEPTION_HANDLING_RECORD' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exception_handling_record h WHERE h.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND h.exception_case_id=#{exceptionId} AND h.id=a.resource_id)) OR (a.resource_type='EXCEPTION_EVIDENCE_ATTACHMENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exception_evidence_attachment ev WHERE ev.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ev.exception_case_id=#{exceptionId} AND ev.id=a.resource_id))) ORDER BY a.occurred_at ASC,a.id ASC
